page.overview:
What is Snodgrass Family?

The Snodgrass Family are Steve Snodgrass’ wife and children, as well as the main antagonists of Help Wanted, the first story of Tales from the Pizzaplex 2: HAPPS. While at first glance, they seem to be a loving family, when in actuality they are a trio of vaguely humanoid bots using illusion discs sent by Fazbear Entertainment LLC to get Steve to comply with them.

Main Article: Steve Snodgrass (Tales from the Pizzaplex) Or were you looking for Steven (disambiguation) or his core series counterpart?Steven Snodgrass is the main protagonist of the story. He was a ordinary guy who worked at a gas station before getting involved with Victoria and their new "family".

Victoria is the antagonist of the story and the "wife" of Steve Snodgrass.

Avery & Abigail are the "children" of Steve and Victoria Snodgrass.
